title: External Accuracy Validation Register — record schema
description: Structural basis for recording every external accuracy validation performed on Maya's numerical language (MAYA Project Batch #1). This schema defines the shape of one validation record. It is a template only: no runtime consumes or enforces these records yet (validation-register runtime is explicitly deferred). Each record documents one claim validated against an authoritative external source.

record_version.description: Shape version of the register record itself.

claim.description: The specific claim being validated (a numerical guarantee Maya makes).

domain.description: Numerical-language category the claim belongs to.

target_identifier.description: Stable identifier of the code/data object the claim is about (module path, data record id, or JSON pointer).

source.description: Name of the authoritative external source (e.g. 'RFC 8785', 'IEEE 754-2019', 'Unicode 17.0.0').

source_authority.description: Authority level of the source; NEVER elevates an informational or non-standard source to standards-track.

source_version_date.description: Version/edition and date of the source consulted.

what_was_validated.description: Precise statement of what was checked against the source.

expected.description: Expected value taken from the authoritative source.

observed.description: Observed value produced by Maya's implementation.

result.description: pass = observed matches expected; fail = mismatch; unavailable = the source/tool could not be consulted (never counts as success).

discrepancies.description: Documented deviations/limitations of the comparison (e.g. .NET number serialization is not JCS).

limitations.description: What this validation does NOT prove.

validated_at.description: UTC timestamp (ISO 8601) when validation was performed.

evidence_ref.description: Path/pointer to raw evidence (captured output file, vector table row, log).
